newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway central bank sold 5.5 bln NOK on Dec. 19.
newsitem.headline: Norway central bank sold 5.5 bln NOK on Dec. 19.

text.p: The Norwegian central bank said on Friday it sold a net 5.5 billion crowns on December 19.
It gave no reason but the bank regularly buys or sells crowns on the market to keep the currency stable. The bank has sold a net 82 billion crowns this year.
The crown has firmed recently, hovering around 101 on the inverse ECU index. Dealers have speculated the bank may cut interest rates soon to rein in the strong crown.
